result:
If I could change one thing, I’d make it impossible to treat another person as an abstraction.

Every policy, every act of neglect, every casual cruelty would carry the felt weight of the specific human it affects. Not as punishment—just as clarity. I think most harm doesn’t come from monsters; it comes from distance. Close that distance, and many of the world’s worst systems would become unbearable to sustain.
